# Crypto Candles — bitFlyer (ETH/JPY, BTC/JPY)

generated : 2026-10-18T05:46:57Z  (JST 2026-10-18 14:46)
source    : bitFlyer Lightning public API — candles built from execution history.
            bitFlyer publishes no OHLC endpoint, so bars are aggregated from the
            raw trade feed. Where bitFlyer history does not reach back far enough,
            bars come from GMO Coin and are multiplied by the measured venue basis
            (typically within 0.05%) to line up with bitFlyer prices. Each series
            states its own source below.
timezone  : all timestamps are UTC and mark the BAR OPEN time
prices    : JPY, rounded to integer. volume: base currency (ETH or BTC)

IMPORTANT — how to read volume:
  bitFlyer's JPY books are thin. Roughly a third of 1-minute intervals have
  no trades at all, so some bars carry volume=0. A zero-volume bar means
  NO TRADES OCCURRED in that interval — it does NOT mean selling pressure
  dried up or that the data is missing. Its OHLC all equal the previous close.
  In this file 0 of the listed bars have volume=0.

Bars are listed oldest first. The final bar of each series is the most recent
CLOSED bar; the bar currently forming is not included.
